Union Minister Backs Mirabai Chanu for Arjuna Award

Union Minister Anurag Thakur has recommended weightlifter Mirabai Chanu for the Arjuna Award in 2026. Chanu expressed her commitment to delivering her best performance at the upcoming Commonwealth Games. The minister's recommendation comes as Chanu prepares for the international sporting event.
